posted: Something Special Planned for them
notes: Format Premiere - Tatooine: posted 16 June 2001, before Coruscant, and the list has no Coruscant-set card (Coruscant and Coruscant: Imperial City are the Special Edition printings).

Starting cards as posted under 'Start 8': Agents of Black Sun / Vengeance Of The Dark Prince, Coruscant, Imperial City, Prince Xizor, Prepared Defenses, Mobilization Points, Imperial Arrest Order, Crush The Rebellion; these count toward the 60. A second Prince Xizor is listed under Characters. Three Effects start (via Prepared Defenses); none is named as the starting Effect, so starting.effect is left empty.
The strategy says 'This is my little brother's deck... (he's 13)'; the brother is not named, so the list is credited to the poster, Karim Jetha.

Posted 'Bossk in the bus' dested Bossk In Hound's Tooth; 'Zuckess in Hunter' dested Zuckuss In Mist Hunter; 'CC East Platform (DB)' dested Cloud City: East Platform (Docking Bay); 'Spaceport Docking Bay' and 'Coruscant' dested the Dark Special Edition pages.

Posted 'Dengar with Blaster' dested Dengar With Blaster Carbine; 'IG-88 with gun' dested IG-88 With Riot Gun; 'Boba Fett with Blaster' dested Boba Fett With Blaster Rifle; '4-Lom with Blaster' dested 4-LOM With Concussion Rifle (the only armed 4-LOM); 'Control Set For Stun' dested the Dark combo Control & Set For Stun.
Secret Plans is an Effect in 2001 (not a Defensive Shield).
The 'Interrupts 22' header was mis-parsed as a card and removed. Total 60.
